concepts.title: Geometrical Meaning of Zeroes
concepts.ncert_text: The zeroes of a polynomial p(x) are the x-coordinates of the points where the graph of y = p(x) intersects the x-axis.

concepts.title: Relationship between Zeroes and Coefficients
concepts.ncert_text: For a quadratic polynomial ax^2 + bx + c: Sum of zeroes (α + β) = -b/a. Product of zeroes (αβ) = c/a.

concepts.title: Relationship for Cubic Polynomials
concepts.ncert_text: For ax^3 + bx^2 + cx + d: α+β+γ = -b/a, αβ+βγ+γα = c/a, αβγ = -d/a.
